Hi, I'm Pranay Kumar, an MCA student driven to become a Software Developer. What sets me apart is my unique approach: I'm not just a coder, I'm also a passionate sketch artist.

I use the creativity, focus, and intricate detail I hone through sketching to solve complex coding problems and build user-centric applications. This combination allows me to be both technically sound and highly innovative in my solutions. I'm enthusiastic about translating creative visions into functional, beautiful code.

I'm looking for opportunities where I can combine my technical knowledge with my creative flair to develop truly exceptional software.
Unique Selling Proposition (USP): Combining sketching creativity with coding.
Proof: "solve complex coding problems and build user-centric applications."
